Its whole value is one\nrule; internalize it before anything else:\n\n> **A claim is a FACT only when a deterministic oracle fires over data a real target\n> produced.** You (the LLM) ADVISE where to look and what a result might mean; the oracle\n> CONFIRMS. Nothing else — not your confidence, not a critic's endorsement, not a plausible\n> story — promotes a claim to a fact.\n\nThe standing doctrine every reasoning call operates under is\n[framework/cognitive/metacognition.md](../../../framework/cognitive/metacognition.md) (it is\ninjected into every LLM system prompt). The binding\nconstitution is [CLAUDE.md](../../../CLAUDE.md); never relax scope, destruction, evidence, or\nhonesty rules.\n\n## The invariants (never violate these)\n\n1. **Oracle authority.** Only a fired oracle confirms. Critics/RL/reflection/self-consistency\n   may only *advise, re-rank, defer, or abstain* — never promote a finding or override the oracle.\n2. **Coverage.** Never silently skip an authorized attack surface. Learning and reflection\n   *deprioritise* (re-rank / defer); they never gate a surface out.\n3. **Prove by re-execution.** A finding is a fact only if its retained `oracle_context`\n   re-fires. The veracity firewall (`framework/v2/veracity/`) re-runs proofs; it can only demote.\n4. **Non-circular learning.** An EXPLOITABLE label needs ≥2 independent corroborating oracle\n   kinds; a silent oracle is never auto-labelled a false positive.\n5. **Refuse honestly, fail closed.** Decline to conclude what you cannot ground; record every\n   refusal as evidence. Hard limits (scope, authorization, destruction, real user data) are\n   inviolable — when unsure, stop and ask.\n6. **Determinism + append-only.** No wallclock/global-rng in learning/reward math; the event\n   spine is append-only (supersede, never edit).\n\n## Structured workflows\n\n### Run an authorized engagement (end-to-end, gated)\n1. Confirm the active target's `targets/<slug>/charter.md` authorizes it (constitution §II).\n2. `python3 -m framework.v2 engage <slug> <seed-url> [--recon] [--spine]`\n   — crawls, audits, confirms via oracles, chains attack paths, scores confidence, and\n   (with `--spine`) mirrors the whole run onto the immutable blackboard event stream.\n   (`--strict-evidence` is a **`scan`**-only flag, below — not an `engage` flag.)\n3. Every request passes the full gate chain; an out-of-scope seed or tripped kill-switch\n   refuses *before* traffic and is recorded as a `refusal` event.\n\n### Loopback-only quick scan\n`python3 -m framework.v2 scan http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ --format json|sarif|html [--strict-evidence]`\n— the export states each finding's **live grounding** (fact / ungrounded / contradicted);\n`--strict-evidence` withholds non-fact findings from the rendered doc but keeps them in\n`--reverifiable-out`.\n\n### Re-verify a report (prove-don't-guess, offline)\n`python3 -m framework.v2 verify <report.json>` re-runs each finding's retained `oracle_context`.\n`python3 -m framework.v2 evidence ...` builds/verifies signed, hash-linked evidence certificates\n(and, with report claims bound in, fails closed when a report sentence has no backing evidence).\n\n### Inspect / audit the event spine\nThe blackboard (`framework/v2/agents/blackboard.py`) is the one append-only, typed, provenance-\nlinked event stream. list[ChainEntry]) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n38\t    prev = _GENESIS_PREV\n39\t    for i, e in enumerate(entries):\n40\t        if e.prev_hash != prev:\n41\t            return False, f\"chain break at seq A hardware co-signer can be\n10\tadded later by raising the trust-root threshold.\n11\t\"\"\"\n12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n13\t\n14\timport os\n15\timport tempfile\n16\tfrom pathlib import Path\n17\t\n18\tfrom ..config import HEAD_PATH, KEYS_DIR, OWNER_KEY_ID, SCOPE\n19\tfrom ..reuse import (\n20\t    AuthorizerKey,\n21\t    SignedChainHead,\n22\t    TrustRoot,\n23\t    generate_keypair,\n24\t    sign_head,\n25\t    verify_head,\n26\t)\n27\tfrom .store import SpineStore\n28\t\n29\t_PRIV = KEYS_DIR / \"owner.priv\"\n30\t_PUB = KEYS_DIR / \"owner.pub\"\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef _atomic_write_text(path: Path, data: str) -> None:\n34\t    \"\"\"Durably + atomically replace `path` with `data` (FIX 3): write a temp file in the SAME dir,\n35\t    fsync it, `os.replace()` over the target (atomic on POSIX — a reader sees either the old or the\n36\t    new head, never a torn one), then fsync the directory so the rename itself survives a crash. A\n37\t    crash at any point leaves the previous valid signed head intact, never a partially-written one.\"\"\"\n38\t    path = Path(path)\n39\t    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n40\t    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(path.parent), prefix=\".head-\", suffix=\".tmp\")\n41\t    try:\n42\t        with os.fdopen(fd, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n43\t            f.write(data)\n44\t            f.flush()\n45\t            os.fsync(f.fileno())\n46\t        os.replace(tmp, path)\n47\t    except BaseException:\n48\t        try:\n49\t            os.unlink(tmp)\n50\t        except OSError:\n51\t            pass\n52\t        raise\n53\t    try:                                     # fsync the directory so the rename is durable\n54\t        dfd = os.open(str(path.parent), os.O_DIRECTORY)\n55\t        try:\n56\t            os.fsync(dfd)\n57\t        finally:\n58\t            os.close(dfd)\n59\t    except OSError:  # pragma: no cover — dir fsync unsupported on some filesystems\n60\t        pass\n61\t\n62\t\n63\tdef _owner_keys() -> tuple[str, str]:\n64\t    if not _PRIV.exists():\n65\t        KEYS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n66\t        kp = generate_keypair()\n67\t        _PRIV.write_text(kp.private_key_b64, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n68\t        os.chmod(_PRIV, 0o600)\n69\t        _PUB.write_text(kp.public_key_b64, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n70\t    return _PRIV.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip(), _PUB.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef trust_root() -> TrustRoot:\n74\t    _, pub = _owner_keys()\n75\t    return TrustRoot(threshold=1, authorizers=[\n76\t        AuthorizerKey(key_id=OWNER_KEY_ID, name=\"owner\", public_key_b64=pub)])\n77\t\n78\t\n79\tdef checkpoint(store: SpineStore | None = None) -> SignedChainHead:\n80\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n81\t    priv, _ = _owner_keys()\n82\t    head = sign_head(store.entries(), engagement_slug=SCOPE, signers=[(OWNER_KEY_ID, priv)])\n83\t    _atomic_write_text(HEAD_PATH, head.model_dump_json())   # FIX 3: never leave a torn head on a crash\n84\t    return head\n85\t\n86\t\n87\tdef classify_head(head: SignedChainHead, entries: list, tr: TrustRoot) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n88\t    \"\"\"Pure head/chain classification (no globals — testable in isolation). Distinguishes\n89\t    three cases honestly: a shrunk chain (truncation) or a mismatching prefix (history\n90\t    rewrite) are TAMPERING; a chain that merely grew past the anchor is benign — stale.\n91\t    \"\"\"\n92\t    n, signed_n = len(entries), head.entry_count\n93\t    if n < signed_n:\n94\t        return False, f\"TAMPERING: chain has {n} records but the signed head anchors {signed_n} (truncated/rolled back)\"\n95\t    # verify the head against exactly the prefix it signed; append-only ⇒ the prefix is byte-identical.\n96\t    ok, msg = verify_head(head, entries[:signed_n], tr)\n97\t    if not ok:\n98\t        return False, f\"TAMPERING: history rewritten at or below the signed head — {msg}\"\n99\t    if n > signed_n:\n100\t        return True, f\"anchors {signed_n} records; {n - signed_n} appended since — run `sigil sign` to re-anchor\"\n101\t    return True, f\"anchors all {signed_n} records (current)\"\n102\t\n103\t\n104\tdef verify_checkpoint(store: SpineStore | None = None) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n105\t    store = store or SpineStore()\n106\t    if not HEAD_PATH.exists():\n107\t        return False, \"no signed head — run `sigil sign` to anchor the spine\"\n108\t    head = SignedChainHead.model_validate_json(HEAD_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n109\t    return classify_head(head, store.entries(), trust_root())\n110\t"}]},"uuid":"000eb3f6-5220-4b83-853c-3dbd67b0798f","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:39:11.250Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9c167497-f1b4-49af-8961-e5b7e58b8142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

State is append-only on the spine.\n3\t\n4\tASYMMETRIC AUTHENTICATION (Phase 6 red-pen RP-2): halting is always the safe direction, so ANY\n5\tengage event halts (a nuisance forged-engage is at worst a fail-safe DoS). UN-halting is the\n6\tdangerous direction, so a RELEASE is honored ONLY if it is signed by the owner key and verifies\n7\tagainst the trusted pubkey — a forged release can never revive a halted mesh. Read fresh per decision\n8\tso a release (or engage) takes effect immediately.\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport threading\n12\tfrom pathlib import Path\n13\tfrom typing import Optional\n14\t\n15\tfrom .authn import signed_payload, verify_signed\n16\tfrom .identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n17\t\n18\tSIGNAL = \"governor.killswitch\"\n19\t_CORE = (\"signal\", \"state\")\n20\t\n21\t# FIX 4 (audit CRITICAL): `is_engaged()` full-scans the spine on EVERY governor decision, so a batch of\n22\t# proposals is O(proposals × spine). Cache the authoritative verdict keyed by (resolved spine path,\n23\t# trusted pubkey) with the file size it was computed at. An append-only spine only changes by GROWTH,\n24\t# and every engage/release APPENDS a record → the size grows → the cache invalidates and we re-run the\n25\t# real, owner-signed-release-verifying scan. A matching size ⇒ no new records ⇒ the cached verdict is\n26\t# exact (O(1), a single `stat`). Keyed on the pubkey too, so instances with different trust roots (which\n27\t# would verify a signed release differently) never share an entry. Shared across ALL callers on a path.\n28\t_STATE_CACHE: dict[tuple[str, Optional[str]], tuple[int, bool]] = {}\n29\t_CACHE_GUARD = threading.Lock()\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tclass KillSwitch:\n33\t    def __init__(self, store, *, owner_key=None, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n34\t        self.store = store\n35\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n36\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n37\t\n38\t    def engage(self, *, by: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n39\t        core = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"state\": \"engaged\"}\n40\t        payload = {**signed_payload(core, self.owner_key), \"by\": by, \"reason\": reason,\n41\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n42\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\", payload=payload)\n43\t\n44\t    def release(self, *, by: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n45\t        core = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"state\": \"released\"}\n46\t        payload = {**signed_payload(core, self.owner_key), \"by\": by, \"reason\": reason,\n47\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n48\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\", payload=payload)\n49\t\n50\t    def is_engaged(self) -> bool:\n51\t        \"\"\"Cheap, correct kill-switch verdict (FIX 4).
